title: SDK failure envelope, discrete exit codes, and user-actionable remediation hints
creator: Maya Alvarez
description: Create a compact, telemetry-friendly failure envelope and a mapped set of discrete exit codes across Python/TS/Go SDKs. Provide machine-readable fields for routing and retry logic plus concise human-facing remediation hints that SDKs surface in exceptions and logs. Ensure streaming aborts and partial-output cases are captured with clear developer guidance.
acceptance_criteria: All SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go) expose an ErrorEnvelope with these string fields: code, numeric_exit, retryable, retry_after_seconds (optional), hint
A canonical mapping table exists tying service-level status codes and runtime errors to the discrete exit codes and high-level categories
SDK exceptions and stream abort callbacks include the hint text verbatim and a stable error id for telemetry
Documentation and migration notes published in SDK CHANGELOGs and Developer Guide
Unit + integration tests validate envelope shape and retryable semantics; e2e tests for streaming abort preserve partial output marker
implementation_notes: Define canonical categories: TRANSIENT(10x), PERMANENT(20x), CLIENT(30x), AUTH(40x), RATE_LIMIT(50x), STREAM_ABORT(60x), PARTIAL_OUTPUT(61x)
Choose numeric_exit range to keep compact; use multiples of 10 to allow future subcodes
Python: provide SDKException(ErrorEnvelope) with properties and __repr__ that includes hint; add helper is_retryable()
TypeScript: throw a typed Error object with envelope attached; runtime type guards and exported map of codes
Go: return typed error implementing interface {Code() string; Exit() int; Retryable() bool; Hint() string}, keep zero allocation path for hot paths
Streaming: attach envelope to stream.Close/Abort events and surface partial_output boolean + partial_url when available
Telemetry: emit stable error_id (sha1 of code+hint) to logs and allow correlation with server-side diagnostics
compatibility_notes: Non-breaking default: existing SDKs will map current error strings to the nearest category. Consumers may opt-in to strict typed errors via a new major flag (e.g., client.enable_strict_error_types=true) before we flip defaults in a major release.
telemetry_surface: error.code (string) - stable short code like TRANSIENT_CONNECTION
error.exit (string) - numeric_exit as string for compact ingestion, e.g., "10"
error.hint (string) - concise remediation guidance up to 140 chars
migration_plan: Q1: merge common error contract spec in SDK repo and publish RFC
Q2: implement in Python and TS SDKs behind feature flag; small consumer beta
Q3: implement Go SDK and add streaming hooks; run customer beta for Dedicated users
Q4: flip default for new minor release once telemetry shows low unexpected mappings
open_questions: Should numeric_exit be exposed as number in JS or string to avoid JS number precision concerns? (JS team prefers string)
What is the max length for hint field in offline logs? (ops asks 256 chars cap)
Do we need language-specific subcodes for SDK-specific failures (e.g., Python GIL stalls)? Prefer avoid if possible
